# Coding Preparation

```{r prep}
#| eval: true
#| warning: false

here::i_am("code/r-scripts/shared.R")

set.seed(123456789)

source(here::here('code/r-scripts/shared.R'), encoding = "UTF-8")

base = read_parquet(here(path$data$processed, 'XXX.parquet'))

base.txt = list(n.rows = nrow(base), n.ids = uniqueN(base$id))
saveRDS(base.txt, here(path$data$auxNN, 'prep.rds'))
```

```{r prep-read}
#| eval: true
base.txt = readRDS(here(path$data$auxNN, 'prep.rds'))
```

We start from `r format(base.txt$n.rows, big.mark = ',')` rows covering
`r format(base.txt$n.ids, big.mark = ',')` individuals.

# Step 1 - [Title]

```{r step-one}
tic()

step.one = base[condition == TRUE]

step.one.txt = data.table(
  n.in   = nrow(base),
  n.out  = nrow(step.one),
  n.drop = nrow(base) - nrow(step.one)
)

saveRDS(step.one.txt, here(path$data$auxNN, 'step-one.rds'))
write_parquet(step.one, here(path$data$processed, 'NN_step-one.parquet'))

rm(step.one)
toc()
```

```{r step-one-read}
#| eval: true
step.one.txt = readRDS(here(path$data$auxNN, 'step-one.rds'))
```

# Output

```{r output}
tic()

final = read_parquet(here(path$data$processed, 'NN_step-one.parquet'))

output.txt = list(
  n.rows      = nrow(final),
  n.ids       = uniqueN(final$id),
  n.duplicate = sum(duplicated(final, by = c('id', 'period'))),
  n.missing   = final[, sum(is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = names(final)]
)

saveRDS(output.txt, here(path$data$auxNN, 'output.rds'))
write_parquet(final, here(path$data$processed, 'NN_file-name.parquet'))

rm(final)
toc()
```

```{r output-read}

output.txt = readRDS(here(path$data$auxNN, 'output.rds'))
```
